# From Maxwell's Equations to Programmable Photonic Circuits

A physics-based numerical study of electromagnetic waves, dielectric
waveguides, directional couplers, Mach-Zehnder interferometers, and
programmable photonic circuits.

## Project Overview

This independent study project develops a computational understanding of
integrated photonics by connecting electromagnetic theory with reduced-order
numerical models.

The project follows the progression

```text
Maxwell's equations
→ electromagnetic waves
→ dielectric waveguide modes
→ coupled-mode theory
→ Mach-Zehnder interferometers
→ programmable photonic circuits
